units.titles: Pool Drainage Due To Rounding Error
units.known_address_notes: OtterSec 2024-01 audited CometDEX/comet-contracts-v1 (Soroban Rust); OS-CMT-ADV-00 is the same-token swap / rounding drain in execute_swap_exact_amount_out. The Aug-2026 exploit post-mortem names the victim pool 'Comet BLND-USDC' CAS3FL6TLZKDGGSISDBWGGPXT3NRR4DYTZD7YOD3HMYO6LTJUVGRVEAM, and StellarExpert attributes that contract to CometDEX/comet-contracts-v1 — the exact audited code. FOUND on Stellar mainnet.

units.titles: 存在无交易费挖矿漏洞
units.known_address_notes: Peckshield PDF text is not extractable (report body marked 'Text unavailable'), so identity was resolved from the project itself: DeFis Network's swap is an EOSIO contract, and the EOS account swap.defi is the deployed swap contract (created 2020-07-21, i.e. the same period as the 2020 audit). Chain is EOS, so there is no EVM address; audit must use the EOS ABI/WASM at this account.

units.titles: Possible funds drain via the deflationary tokens in MasterChef
units.known_address_notes: Chain was 'unknown' in corpus. Decurity report scope links point at andromeda-explorer.metis.io (Metis Andromeda, chain id 1088); DefiLlama lists Tethys AMM on Metis. All three audited contracts are verified on Metis and return non-empty code. The finding is the MasterChef deflationary-token drain.
